description: Infer potential service boundaries and analyze service organization strategies

artifacts.description: Service organization strategy analysis and recommendation

actions.description: Analyze functional architecture for service organization patterns
actions.llm_guidance:
Run: python3 {tools_path}/analyze_service_organization.py {system_root}

This tool analyzes:
- Coordination complexity
- Workflow span
- Operation types (CRUD, Workflow, REAL_TIME)
- Extensibility requirements

And recommends: PLUGIN_BASED, DOMAIN_BASED, WORKFLOW_BASED, or HYBRID

actions.description: Evaluate the tool's recommendation against system specifics
actions.llm_guidance:
Consider:
- Does the recommendation match the system type?
- For real-time systems (games, emulators): PLUGIN_BASED or HYBRID usually best
- For CRUD apps: DOMAIN_BASED often sufficient
- For workflow-heavy systems: WORKFLOW_BASED appropriate

Make an EDUCATED recommendation - don't just echo the tool output!

actions.description: Based on chosen strategy, define service/module boundaries
actions.llm_guidance:
For PLUGIN_BASED:
- Identify swappable components (backends, handlers, providers)
- Define Protocol interfaces for each

For DOMAIN_BASED:
- Group by business domain
- Identify shared services

For HYBRID:
- Combine approaches per component need
- Document which pattern applies where

actions.description: Map functional clusters to proposed services
actions.llm_guidance:
Create mapping:
- functional_cluster -> proposed_service
- Document rationale for each allocation
- Note any functions that span services

criteria: Service organization strategy chosen with rationale
All functional clusters mapped to services

notes: For monolithic legacy systems, the 'service' may actually be a single package with multiple modules. The key output is the organizational strategy, not necessarily microservices.
